def hr(g,r,c,sd):
    n=0;k=c
    while True:
        p=k+sd
        if 0<=p<len(g[0]) and g[r][p]==g[r][c]: n+=1;p+=sd
        else: break
    return n
def vr(g,r,c,sd):
    n=0;k=r
    while True:
        p=k+sd
        if 0<=p<len(g) and g[p][c]==g[r][c]: n+=1;p+=sd
        else: break
    return n
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            L,R,hn=hr(g,r,c,-1),hr(g,r,c,1),L+1+R
            U,D,vn=vr(g,r,c,-1),vr(g,r,c,1),U+1+D
            # isolated if max run through cell in either axis is 1
            iso = hn==1 or vn==1
            cand={}
            for dr_,dc_ in ((0,0),(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
                rr_=r+dr_; cc_=c+dc_
                if 0<=rr_<H and 0<=cc_<W: cand[g[rr_][cc_]]=cand.get(g[rr_][cc_],0)+1
            best,m=cand.most_common(1)[0]
            if iso and (m!=g[r][c]): out[r][c]=best
    return out

def f(A):
    A=np.array(A); h,w=A.shape
    dom=Counter(A.flat).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=A.copy()
    def nb(r,c):
        return [(A[y,x],y==r and x==c) for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=r+dy<h and 0<=c+dx<w]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            vals=[v for v,_ in nb(r,c)]
            if len(set(vals))==1 and vals[0]!=dom: continue
            # majority among neighbors
            cnt=Counter(v for v,_ in nb(r,c))
            mx=max(cnt.values())
            tied=[k for k,v in cnt.items() if v==mx]
            out[r,c]=min(tied) if len(tied)>1 else tied[0]
    return out.tolist()
